profile:
### Magenta Surf (G4)

**Who is she?** A pale pink-lilac Earth-pony mare with a vivid turquoise-blue mane and light aqua eyes, best recognized as one of pop star **Sapphire Shores’ backup dancers** in *For Whom the Sweetie Belle Toils* (season 4, episode 19). She is part of the troupe whose stage costumes Rarity has been hired to make. [Character listing](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Mares).

**Name and identity.** “Magenta Surf” is the name used by the fan-maintained character index; I did not verify it in dialogue, official credits, or merchandise, so its official naming status is **unconfirmed**. Do **not** confuse her with the separate background mare **Surf**, who speaks to Fluttershy in *Putting Your Hoof Down*. Their color schemes are similar, not proof that they are the same pony.

**Appearances.** *For Whom the Sweetie Belle Toils* (2014); the character index also identifies her in IDW’s *Friends Forever* #37 and in a photograph in *Rarity’s Peek Behind the Boutique*, episode 1. The latter identifications have not been independently checked against those images. [Episode listing](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/por-quien-brillan-los-reflectores/umc.cmc.5hberbgcq81o386cong7j2n9x?l=es&showId=umc.cmc.3ujevsytv3nqn8uolyrrgws8j).

**Speaking and design.** No separately attributable line or verified voice actor was found. No distinct cutie-mark design or alter ego was verified.
